inputs.text: [excited] PA… rah… sor… OL… oh… fus. [curious] "Para," in ancient Greek, means beside, almost the same as. "Sauro" is lizard. And "lophus" is crest.
[happily] Exactly. [warmly] A long hollow crest, curving backward. He lived in North America, seventy-six million years ago.
[nervous] And were there scary dinosaurs around there?
[serious] Yes. T. rex hunted in that area. [confident] So his herd stayed very alert.
